summary: Appeal against death penalty for triple murder by arson; prosecution based on eyewitness testimony (PW-2, PW-4), dying declarations; High Court dismissed appeal confirming death sentence; credibility challenges on witness presence, door condition; medico-legal evidence corroborated burn injuries; trial court convicted under Sections 302, 436, 326-A IPC; death penalty upheld following re-evaluation of aggravating/mitigating circumstances.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; death sentence confirmed with life imprisonment for multiple counts upheld.
